newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Saudi man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Saudi man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Tuesday beheaded a Saudi man for shooting dead a male compatriot, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television said the victim was killed by several machinegun bullets.
The beheading in Saudi Arabia's Eastern province was the fourth execution in the conservative kingdom this year.
Saudi Arabia executed 68 people in 1996. The kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law, publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
